I recommend Book Bond to everyone who needs to find the best (age appropriate) books for their little ones and have great guidance from their team while doing so. Cannot wait to buy my next set of books from them :)

featured_reviews.name: Anshika Maheshwari
featured_reviews.review_text: I’ve bought over 100 books from Book Bond over the years, and earlier this year subscribed to their monthly subscription box. It’s been an outstanding experience so far. The books are curated for my children’s age and it’s evident that a lot of thought has been put into choosing every book. My girls eagerly wait for their subscription box every month :)

featured_reviews.name: Pankhuri Verma
featured_reviews.review_text:
I took subscription from Book bond online and really liked the concept of subscription.
Book bond has really good collections of books and my child has enjoyed a lot :)

featured_reviews.name: Sabina Yasmin
featured_reviews.review_text:
I've always been an avid reader of all sorts of books, and now, every single day, my heart fills with joy seeing my little one show the same interest and enthusiasm with her amazing and interactive books collection from Book Bond.
As much as she enjoys running around the house on her tiny feet, doing all sorts of innocent mischief, and helping with chores, I've quietly noticed her love for books. All thanks to Book Bond!
While she adores herself in the mirror and throws the occasional tantrum, sometimes leaving cute trails of destruction, watching her turn the pages and then coming to me or her papa to ask us to read to her fills my heart with joy. I'm happy that these tiny resemblances are shaping her beautifully, and there's no way we would have parented her otherwise.
It couldn't have been possible if I hadn't stumbled upon this amazing book store. After all, what better way to reduce kid's screen time than to foster their love for reading, right?

name: Osho Books - Mumbai
description:
Hello folks, it is a pleasure to see you here.

Let me begin by introducing myself first before I share more about the bookshop.

I am Anand Utsav, which as Osho says, means joyful celebration, and this book shop is my biggest ever expanding & unending celebration.

The feeling of spreading Osho's love, through his videos and books, came as the most wonderful way to be with Him & share His love and light as far as one possibly could.

Oshobooks, initially started as a small book store, in the late 80s, just around the corner in Malad, West Mumbai, an area with the day-to-day traffic of all kinds of people and rickshaws and trucks.

Slowly, it emerged to be a place, of warmth and care.

With Love...

Anandutsav

I must express my admiration for the carefully curated reviews featured on the website. Each testimonial offers a unique perspective and insight into the transformative power of Osho's teachings. The diverse range of voices and experiences showcased in these reviews further validates the profound impact that Osho's wisdom has on individuals from various walks of life.

I believe that the "Reviews" section not only serves as a source of inspiration but also fosters a sense of community among fellow seekers. It provides a space where readers can connect with others who have found solace, clarity, and personal growth through Osho's teachings. This sense of connection and shared experiences is invaluable in a world that often feels disconnected and fragmented.

I encourage the OshoBooks in Mumbai & Swami Anand Utsav ji team to continue nurturing and expanding the "Reviews" section. Once again, I express my deepest appreciation for the profound impact OshoBooks in Mumbai & Swami Anand Utsav ji has had on my spiritual journey. Your commitment to spreading Osho's teachings and providing a space for reflection and connection is truly remarkable.

Thank you for your time, and I look forward to witnessing the continued growth and inspiration that OshoBooks in Mumbai brings to spiritual seekers.

With heartfelt gratitude,
-Felix
